female.translationZh: 女性立法者比男性更有可能提出、讨论并努力推动通过那些对妇女和女童有较大影响的政策，如带薪家庭假、薪酬公平和基于性别的暴力问题相关政策。
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

female.sentenceEn: On the contrary, decades of research shows that female candidates raise as much money and win as often as male politicians with similar credentials.
female.translationZh: 相反，数十年的研究表明，在资历相似的情况下，女性候选人募集的资金与男性政客相当，当选率也不相上下。
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

female.sentenceEn: In the next Congress, there will be 107 female Democratic lawmakers and 42 female Republican lawmakers in the Senate and House combined.
female.translationZh: 在下一届国会中，参众两院将共有107名民主党女性议员和42名共和党女性议员。
female.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

female.sentenceEn: Male editors of top psychology and neuroscience journals tend to be biased against their female colleagues.
female.translationZh: 顶尖心理学和神经科学期刊的男性编辑往往对其女性同事存在偏见。

function.sentenceEn: "Evidence suggests that older adults show preserved, and at times enhanced, creativity as a function of enriched memories," the researchers write.
function.translationZh: 研究人员写道：“有证据表明，老年人的创造力会因丰富的记忆而保持甚至有时会增强。”
function.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

function.sentenceEn: The system that makes kitchens function is called "mise-en-place", or literally "put in place".
function.translationZh: 让厨房高效运作的系统被称为"mise-en-place"，字面意思是"各就各位"。
function.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

function.sentenceEn: Humans then bred dogs with the most desirable and useful traits so that they could function as companions and workers.
function.translationZh: 随后，人类开始培育具有最理想和最有用特质的狗，使它们能够充当伴侣和工作伙伴。
function.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

function.sentenceEn: Among other functions , this network helps to consolidate memory and understand others' emotions.
function.translationZh: 除其他功能外，该网络还有助于巩固记忆和理解他人情绪。

function.sentenceEn: It took scientists a long time to realise that the function of forests goes far beyond providing humans with timber.
function.translationZh: 科学家花了很长时间才意识到森林的功能远不止为人类提供木材。

function.sentenceEn: Courts are getting too bureaucratic to function .
function.translationZh: 法院的官僚化程度过高，已影响其正常运作。

fossil.sentenceEn: But these cities often have small populations, occasionally still rely on fossil fuel energy and have significant renewable resources at their immediate disposal.
fossil.translationZh: 但这些城市往往人口较少，偶尔仍依赖化石燃料能源，并且拥有大量可随时利用的可再生资源。
fossil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

fossil.sentenceEn: For instance, many new human fossils found, particularly in China, are now dated as older than 60,000 years.
fossil.translationZh: 例如，近年来发现的许多人类化石（尤其是在中国发现的），其年代现已确定超过6万年。
fossil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

fossil.sentenceEn: Before the 20th century, a handful of scientists had been interested in the theoretical relationship between greenhouse gases and climate change, but only the empirical evidence accumulated since the late 20th century established a clear connection between the burning of fossil fuels and a vastly accelerated rise in global temperatures.
fossil.translationZh: 20世纪之前，仅有少数科学家对温室气体与气候变化之间的理论关系感兴趣，但直到20世纪后期积累的经验证据才明确确立了化石燃料燃烧与全球气温急剧上升之间的联系。

fossil.sentenceEn: The Sierra Club's Beyond Coal campaign, which also leads campaigns for universities to withdraw their investments in coal and other fossil fuels, lists 22 schools that have pledged to move "beyond coal," including Clemson University, Indiana University, Ohio University, Penn State University, the University of Louisville and the University of Tennessee, Knoxville.
fossil.translationZh: 塞拉俱乐部的“超越煤炭”运动也领导着推动大学撤资煤炭及其他化石燃料的行动，该运动列出了22所承诺“超越煤炭”的学校，包括克莱姆森大学、印第安纳大学、俄亥俄大学、宾夕法尼亚州立大学、路易斯维尔大学以及田纳西大学诺克斯维尔分校。
fossil.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

fossil.sentenceEn: Fossil fuels remain the major source of primary energy consumption in today's world.
fossil.translationZh: 化石燃料仍然是当今世界一次能源消费的主要来源。

fossil.sentenceEn: It is debatable whether traditional fossil fuel energy can be done away with entirely throughout the world.
fossil.translationZh: 全球范围内是否能够完全摒弃传统化石燃料能源，这一问题尚有争议。

firm.sentenceEn: We therefore comb through the fine details of all contracts, rest assured, we all appreciate your firm's patience.
firm.translationZh: 因此，我们正在仔细梳理所有合同的细节。请放心，我们都非常感谢贵公司的耐心等待。
firm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

firm.sentenceEn: In fact, technology firms often purposely design devices that will not last long and cannot be repaired so that consumers will have to spend their money on a new one.
firm.translationZh: 事实上，科技公司常常刻意设计使用寿命短且无法维修的设备，迫使消费者不得不花钱购买新设备。
firm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

firm.sentenceEn: Monitoring employee performance gives firms the ability to assess how their staff are performing and interacting, which can be good for both the firm and employees themselves.
firm.translationZh: 监控员工绩效使公司能够评估员工的工作表现和互动情况，这对公司和员工自身都可能有益。
firm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

firm.sentenceEn: But it's on the rise around the world as firms look to become more efficient by squeezing more productivity from their workers.
firm.translationZh: 但随着企业试图通过压榨员工以提高生产力来提升效率，这种做法在全球范围内呈上升趋势。
firm.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

firm.sentenceEn: Soon neighbouring farmers started placing orders with him, and now his firm , Illuminum Greenhouses, has sold more than 1,400 greenhouses that provide livelihoods to about 6,000 people.
firm.translationZh: 很快，周边的农民开始向他订购，如今他的公司Illuminum Greenhouses已售出1400多个温室大棚，为约6000人提供了生计。

firm.sentenceEn: It enables firms to squeeze maximal productivity from employees.
firm.translationZh: 这使企业能够从员工身上榨取最大生产力。

funding.sentenceEn: M: Actually, we support teams for secondary school students, too, and also have some public funding .
funding.translationZh: 男：实际上，我们也支持中学生队伍，并且还获得了一些公共资金。
funding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

funding.sentenceEn: Millions of dollars of investor funding and years of labor were lost.
funding.translationZh: 数百万美元的投资者资金和数年的心血付诸东流。

funding.sentenceEn: Institutions and funding organisations should support more researchers to publish in open access journals so that the public doesn't have to pay to read them.
funding.translationZh: 科研机构和资助组织应支持更多研究人员在开放获取期刊上发表论文，这样公众就无需付费阅读这些研究成果。
funding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

funding.sentenceEn: Most universities have turned to natural gas as a replacement, with state funding backing the fuel switch.
funding.translationZh: 大多数大学已转向天然气作为替代能源，州政府资金为这种燃料转换提供了支持。
funding.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

funding.sentenceEn: Being short of funding and qualified teachers, schools lag behind the fast developing computer science field.
funding.translationZh: 由于资金短缺和合格教师不足，学校难以跟上计算机科学领域的快速发展。

funding.sentenceEn: Literature should get as much funding as engineering.
funding.translationZh: 文学应该获得与工程学同等的资金支持。

flight.sentenceEn: If it's too fast, the bags may make the connection but the passengers might miss the flight .
flight.translationZh: 如果转机速度太快，行李可能跟得上了，但乘客却未必能赶上飞机。
flight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

flight.sentenceEn: Most delayed bags are only one flight behind their owners and can be delivered within 24 hours.
flight.translationZh: 大多数延误的行李仅比其所有者晚一个航班，通常可在 24 小时内送达。
flight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

flight.sentenceEn: Bad weather and flight delays, miscoded destination tags and some people simply forgetting to pick up one of their bags are a few of the reasons.
flight.translationZh: 恶劣天气和航班延误、目的地标签录入错误，以及一些人单纯忘了取走某件行李，都是造成这一现象的原因。
flight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

flight.sentenceEn: If the system moves too slowly, the bags won't make connecting flights .
flight.translationZh: 如果系统运行太慢，行李将无法赶上中转航班。
flight.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

flight.sentenceEn: Why didn't the woman's grandmother take her scheduled flight ?
flight.translationZh: 为什么这位女士的祖母没有乘坐她预定的航班？

flight.sentenceEn: Its owner's flight is delayed because of bad weather.
flight.translationZh: 它的主人乘坐的航班因天气恶劣而延误了。

frequently.sentenceEn: Embarrassing failures in restaurant tech frequently hit the headlines.
frequently.translationZh: 餐饮科技领域的尴尬失败案例频频登上头条新闻。

frequently.sentenceEn: The researchers found that parents who read the printed books pointed more frequently to pages than parents who read the electronic books.
frequently.translationZh: 研究人员发现，与阅读电子书的家长相比，阅读纸质书的家长更频繁地指点书页。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

frequently.sentenceEn: But again, these altered menu designs backfired with those who ate vegetarian food more frequently , leading them to be less likely to choose a vegetarian dish.
frequently.translationZh: 但同样地，这些改动后的菜单设计在那些经常吃素的人群中起到了反作用，导致他们选择素食的可能性降低了。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

frequently.sentenceEn: The study involved 750 people, half of whom frequently ate vegetarian food and half of whom rarely ate it.
frequently.translationZh: 这项研究涉及 750 人，其中一半人经常吃素食，另一半人则很少食用。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

frequently.sentenceEn: It's frequently noted that fertility rates are falling sharply in richer countries.
frequently.translationZh: 人们常注意到，富裕国家的生育率正在急剧下降。
frequently.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

frequently.sentenceEn: They violate traffic rules more frequently .
frequently.translationZh: 他们更频繁地违反交通规则。

fund.sentenceEn: Thus, had he owned some land in Athens itself, including the land the tree sat on, presumably he would have sold it to raise funds or otherwise had it taken as well.
fund.translationZh: 因此，假如他在雅典本身拥有一些土地，包括那棵树所在的土地，想必他也会将其出售以筹集资金，否则也会被没收。

fund.sentenceEn: Over the prior three years, he and his crew had obtained 14 state permits to survey a nearly 260-square-kilometer area off the cape; they worked 250 days a year, backed by investor funds of, he claims, US $4 million.
fund.translationZh: 在过去三年中，他和他的团队获得了14项州级许可，用于勘测海角附近近260平方公里的海域；他们每年工作250天，他声称这得到了400万美元投资者资金的支持。

fund.sentenceEn: Ironically, the new tax on endowments drains financial aid funds from the very schools most able to offer opportunity to those who have earned a spot but cannot otherwise afford this education.
fund.translationZh: 具有讽刺意味的是，这项针对捐赠基金的新税收，恰恰从那些最有能力为已获得入学资格却无力负担学费的学生提供机会的学校中，抽走了助学金资金。
fund.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

fund.sentenceEn: We have built endowments from donations by alumni(校友) and parents who understand and appreciate our mission to provide access and opportunity, and a significant portion of the returns from these endowments is used to fund financial aid.
fund.translationZh: 我们通过校友和家长的捐赠建立了捐赠基金，他们理解并认同我们提供教育机会的使命。这些捐赠基金产生的收益中有很大一部分用于资助助学金。
fund.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

fund.sentenceEn: What does the author think of college students funding their education through loans?
fund.translationZh: 作者如何看待大学生通过贷款支付学费这一行为？

fund.sentenceEn: College students should fund their own education.
fund.translationZh: 大学生应当自行负担其教育费用。

federal.sentenceEn: According to a new study from academics at Harvard, the stagnation can be put down, perhaps counterintuitively, to the introduction of state and federal family leave policies.
federal.translationZh: 哈佛大学学者的一项新研究表明，停滞不前的原因或许与直觉相反，竟是州和联邦家庭休假政策的出台。
federal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

federal.sentenceEn: As federal subsidies and land grants tempted people into the deserts and plains, the post kept them connected.
federal.translationZh: 当联邦补贴和土地授予吸引人们前往沙漠和平原地区时，邮政服务让他们与外界保持着联系。
federal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

federal.sentenceEn: The federal government commissioned private wagons to carry the mail.
federal.translationZh: 联邦政府委托私人马车运送邮件。
federal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

federal.sentenceEn: In 2018, two long years after Pritchett's discovery, the federal district court ruled in favor of France.
federal.translationZh: 2018年，在普里切特发现沉船整整两年后，联邦地方法院做出了有利于法国的裁决。

federal.sentenceEn: What happened with the introduction of state and federal family leave policies?
federal.translationZh: 州和联邦家庭休假政策实施后发生了什么？

federal.sentenceEn: It extended the influence of the federal government.
federal.translationZh: 它扩大了联邦政府的影响力。

finally.sentenceEn: With less time spent focused on regrets, you'll finally have time to focus on the more essential things in life.
finally.translationZh: 少花点时间纠结于过去，你终将有精力去关注生活中更重要的事情。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

finally.sentenceEn: Finally , in San Francisco the first red and green electric light system that could be operated automatically (or manually) was introduced in 1917.
finally.translationZh: 最终，旧金山于1917年引入了首套可自动（或手动）操作的红绿电力信号灯系统。

finally.sentenceEn: Finally , on October 9, 1942, the over 30 meter tall and 200-400 year old tree fell, rumor has it, as a result of a severe windstorm and/or via having previously died and its roots rotted.
finally.translationZh: 最终，在1942年10月9日，这棵高达30多米、树龄200-400年的古树倒下了。据传，其原因可能是一场强烈的风暴，也可能是树木先前已经枯死，根部腐烂所致。

finally.sentenceEn: Finally , they read a list of TV programmes and indicated which they regularly watched.
finally.translationZh: 最后，他们阅读了一份电视节目清单，并指出了哪些是他们经常观看的。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

finally.sentenceEn: Finally , the researchers asked them to recall what their belief had been at the start of the study.
finally.translationZh: 最后，研究人员让他们回忆在研究开始时自己的信念是什么。
finally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

finally.sentenceEn: What do we learn about the wine the man finally bought?
finally.translationZh: 关于这位男士最终购买的葡萄酒，我们了解到什么信息？

familiar.sentenceEn: Meeting recovery syndrome is a concept that should be familiar to almost anyone who has held a formal job.
familiar.translationZh: 会议恢复期综合征是几乎所有有过正式工作经历的人都应该熟悉的概念。

familiar.sentenceEn: Fruitful debates might actually take place in this area, as opposed to the familiar ritual we've become accustomed to of condemnation met with counter-condemnation.
familiar.translationZh: 在这一领域或许能开展富有成效的辩论，而非我们早已习惯的那种相互谴责的熟悉套路。

familiar.sentenceEn: The name may not sound familiar to you, but John was once an acclaimed basketball player.
familiar.translationZh: 你可能对这个名字不太熟悉，但约翰曾是一位备受赞誉的篮球运动员。
familiar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

familiar.sentenceEn: Set aside, for the moment, the familiar argument for higher wages: fairness.
familiar.translationZh: 暂且不论提高工资的常见理由——公平性。
familiar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

familiar.sentenceEn: On the topic of trade, productive debates might be possible, in contrast to the familiar mutual condemnation in discussing other issues.
familiar.translationZh: 在贸易议题上，或许有可能进行富有成效的辩论，这与在讨论其他问题时常见的相互指责形成了对比。

familiar.sentenceEn: People growing up in a small community may find it easy to remember familiar faces.
familiar.translationZh: 在小型社区长大的人可能会发现很容易记住熟悉的面孔。

facility.sentenceEn: On the other hand, if your home is architecturally unique or has facilities for the traveler, such as a private entrance, private bath or swimming pool, people may be willing to go some distance to reach you.
facility.translationZh: 另一方面，如果你的住所建筑风格独特，或者拥有方便旅客的设施（如独立入口、私人浴室或游泳池），人们或许愿意长途跋涉前去投宿。
facility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

facility.sentenceEn: Due to both the distance between residences and facilities and often intermittent public transport, those living in the countryside are heavier automobile users.
facility.translationZh: 由于住所与设施之间距离较远，加上公共交通往往断断续续，农村居民对汽车的使用更为频繁。
facility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

facility.translationZh: 电池会在回收工厂发生爆炸。
facility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

facility.sentenceEn: We've come to believe that a good college should have many academic programs and excellent facilities , posh(豪华的) dorms, an array of athletic programs, and a world-class student activity center.
facility.translationZh: 我们逐渐认为，一所优秀的大学应该拥有众多学术项目和一流设施、豪华宿舍、一系列体育项目以及世界级的学生活动中心。

facility.sentenceEn: With several monitoring stations operating in Antarctica, Russia is trying hard to counter America's dominance in the field of worldwide navigational facilities .
facility.translationZh: 俄罗斯在南极洲运营着多个监测站，正努力挑战美国在全球导航设施领域的主导地位。

facility.sentenceEn: Invest in constructing more recycling facilities .
facility.translationZh: 投资建设更多回收设施。

fault.sentenceEn: I understand it might not be your fault , but nevertheless, you should know what the feeling is around here.
fault.translationZh: 我明白这可能不是你的错，但不管怎样，你应该了解一下这里的氛围。
fault.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

fault.sentenceEn: Who is more at fault , Bass asks, the professional archaeologist who carefully excavates a site and never publishes on it or the treasure hunter who locates a submerged wreck, salvages part, conserves part, and publishes a book on the operation?
fault.translationZh: 巴斯问道：一位专业考古学家精心发掘了遗址却从不发表研究成果，与一位找到水下沉船、打捞部分文物、保存部分文物并出版相关著作的寻宝者相比，谁的过失更大？

fault.sentenceEn: You can begin by acknowledging that you are at fault , taking responsibility for the hurt you caused, then reflecting on why the event occurred.
fault.translationZh: 你可以先承认自己有错，为自己造成的伤害承担责任，然后反思事情发生的原因。
fault.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

fault.sentenceEn: But according to recent research conducted in Australia, it looks like it's not the employees' fault but the managers'.
fault.translationZh: 但根据澳大利亚近期开展的研究，问题似乎并不在员工身上，而在于管理者。
fault.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

fault.sentenceEn: For example, if I were to discover a newborn at my front door, it wouldn't be my fault , but it most certainly would be my responsibility.
fault.translationZh: 例如，倘若我在自家门前发现一名弃婴，这虽非我的过错，但无疑是我的责任。
fault.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

fault.sentenceEn: A distinction should be drawn between responsibility and fault .
fault.translationZh: 我们应当区分责任和过错。

fountain.sentenceEn: Otherwise, the growing piles of pennies, quarters and euros could clog up the fountains' works.
fountain.translationZh: 否则，越积越多的便士、25美分硬币和欧元硬币可能会堵塞喷泉的运转机制。
fountain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

flamingo.sentenceEn: " Flamingos have evolved very leathery skin on their legs so they can tolerate the salt water," says David Harper, a professor at the University of Leicester.
flamingo.translationZh: 莱斯特大学教授大卫·哈珀说：“火烈鸟的腿部进化出了非常坚韧的皮肤，因此它们能够耐受盐水。”
flamingo.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

flamingo.sentenceEn: The lake's landscape is bizarre and deadly—and made even more so by the fact that it's the place where nearly 75 percent of the world's flamingos (火烈鸟) are born.
flamingo.translationZh: 这座湖泊的景观怪诞而致命——而更令人称奇的是，这里竟是全球近75%的火烈鸟的诞生地。
flamingo.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

flamingo.sentenceEn: Flamingos , however, are the only species that actually makes life in the midst of all that death.
flamingo.translationZh: 然而，火烈鸟却是唯一一种能在这片死亡之地中繁衍生息的物种。
flamingo.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

flexibility.sentenceEn: Brainstorming, which requires creativity, flexibility , and emotional intelligence, is a typical problem-solving technique.
flexibility.translationZh: 头脑风暴是一种典型的解决问题的方法，它需要创造力、灵活性和情商。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

flexibility.sentenceEn: Caroline Wagner, a research scientist at George Washington University, notes that international collaborations offer additional flexibility .
flexibility.translationZh: 乔治·华盛顿大学的研究科学家卡罗琳·瓦格纳指出，国际合作提供了额外的灵活性。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

flexibility.sentenceEn: All the universities are owned by the government, so there is the Ministry of Education in charge of creating the curriculum for the universities and so there's not much room for flexibility .
flexibility.translationZh: 所有大学都归政府所有，因此由教育部负责制定大学课程，所以灵活性不大。
flexibility.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

flexibility.sentenceEn: It's important to note that the increased flexibility didn't encourage them to work around the clock.
flexibility.translationZh: 值得注意的是，这种增强的灵活性并未促使他们全天候工作。

flexibility.sentenceEn: The problem isn't the technology itself, but that the technology is being used to create more flexibility for the employer rather than the employee.
flexibility.translationZh: 问题不在于技术本身，而在于技术正被用来为雇主而非员工创造更多灵活性。

flexibility.sentenceEn: Flexibility resulting from the use of digital devices benefits employers instead of employees.
flexibility.translationZh: 数字设备带来的灵活性造福了雇主而非员工。

flip.sentenceEn: For Flippy is a robot — a cloud-connected mechanical arm with 3D thermal scanners for eyes — that can flip burgers or fry 80 baskets of food an hour, monitor that food and even clean up afterwards.
flip.translationZh: Flippy 是一款云端联网机器人——它拥有带 3D 热扫描仪的机械臂作为双眼——每小时不仅能翻转汉堡或炸制 80 篮食物，还能监控食物状态，甚至在事后完成清理工作。

flip.sentenceEn: The officer would flip a switch to change between the dipped red and green lights.
flip.translationZh: 军官会拨动开关，在变暗的红绿灯光之间切换。

flip.sentenceEn: If an emergency vehicle came, the officer could flip a switch and clear the intersection by triggering all red lights.
flip.translationZh: 如果救急车辆驶来，警员可以拨动开关，通过触发全红灯信号来清空十字路口。

flip.sentenceEn: A booth with an operator was required to flip the switches.
flip.translationZh: 过去需要专门的隔间和操作员来切换开关。

flip.sentenceEn: If the tone of a dialogue heats up and anger erupts, the dialogue flips from collaborative to adversarial, and progress is likely to come to an immediate halt.
flip.translationZh: 如果对话的语气变得激烈并爆发愤怒，对话就会从合作性转变为对抗性，进展很可能会立即停滞。
flip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

flip.sentenceEn: The flip side of this is that many studies have actually shown poorer language skills correlated with earlier solo viewing of "educational" videos.
flip.translationZh: 但另一方面，许多研究实际上表明，过早独自观看"教育"视频与较差的语言能力相关。
flip.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

float.sentenceEn: A scent is a chemical particle that floats in through the nose and into the region of the brain responsible for smell, where the sensation is first processed into a form that the brain can read.
float.translationZh: 气味是一种化学微粒，它通过鼻子进入大脑中负责嗅觉的区域，在那里，这种感觉首先被处理成大脑能够识别的形式。
float.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

float.sentenceEn: Along the route, armed guards wandered the large sheets of floating ice to minimize the risk of polar bear attacks.
float.translationZh: 沿途，武装警卫在巨大的浮冰上巡逻，以最大限度降低北极熊袭击的风险。

float.sentenceEn: Ash covered the marble diamond-patterned floor and floated in large pools of grey water from the fire hoses.
float.translationZh: 大理石菱形图案的地面上覆盖着一层灰烬，消防水龙喷出的灰色积水里也漂浮着灰烬。

float.sentenceEn: Most of the remains probably floated down an eastward flowing river until they were left on a shallow sandbar.
float.translationZh: 大部分遗骸可能是顺着一条向东流淌的河流漂下来，最终被冲到一片浅水沙洲上。
float.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

float.sentenceEn: Some of the swamp dwellers may have got stuck in the very sandbar that became their grave; others may have floated for miles before being stranded.
float.translationZh: 一些沼泽栖息动物可能被困在了那片最终成为它们坟墓的沙洲上；另一些则可能漂流了数英里后才搁浅。
float.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

float.sentenceEn: They floated down an eastward flowing river.
float.translationZh: 它们顺着一条向东流淌的河流漂流而下。

follower.sentenceEn: This led us to start We Are Travel Girls, which has now grown into a community of over 200,000 followers .
follower.translationZh: 这启发我们创立了"We Are Travel Girls"，如今它已发展成为一个拥有超过20万粉丝的社群。
follower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

follower.sentenceEn: One woman in Britain has become a social media sensation with more than two million followers for her cleaning tips page.
follower.translationZh: 英国一位女性凭借其清洁技巧分享页面在社交媒体上走红，吸引了超过两百万粉丝。
follower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

follower.sentenceEn: The positive stress movement is made up of people such as Zachary Rapp who are looking for an edge in a competitive world, and Rapp's routine is a good example of followers of the movement.
follower.translationZh: 积极压力运动由像扎卡里·拉普这样的人组成，他们希望在竞争激烈的世界中获得优势，而拉普的日常生活正是该运动追随者的一个典范。
follower.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

follower.sentenceEn: Piaget and his followers maintained that children go through something like a dark age of intellectual development before slowly and gradually becoming enlightened by reason and rationality as they reach school age.
follower.translationZh: 皮亚杰及其追随者认为，儿童在进入学龄期前会经历一个类似智力发展"黑暗时代"的阶段，之后才会慢慢被理性和理智所启蒙。

follower.sentenceEn: What do we learn about followers of the positive stress movement?
follower.translationZh: 关于积极压力运动的追随者，我们了解到什么？

follower.sentenceEn: She has won Instagram's most followers .
follower.translationZh: 她曾是Instagram上粉丝最多的用户

formal.sentenceEn: Some are friendly and open; some are formal and distant.
formal.translationZh: 有些人友好开朗，有些人则正式疏离。
formal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

formal.sentenceEn: Yet while no formal MRS studies are currently underway, one can loosely speculate on the length of an average employee's lag time.
formal.translationZh: 然而，尽管目前尚无正式的边际替代率研究在进行中，但我们可以大致推测普通员工的延迟时间长度。

formal.sentenceEn: Meeting recovery syndrome is a concept that should be familiar to almost anyone who has held a formal job.
formal.translationZh: 会议恢复期综合征是几乎所有有过正式工作经历的人都应该熟悉的概念。

formal.sentenceEn: To identify key patterns and understand the underlying principles of variability effects, Raviv and her colleagues reviewed over 150 studies on variability and generalisation across fields, including computer science, linguistics, categorisation, visual perception and formal education.
formal.translationZh: 为了识别关键模式并理解变异效应的基本原理，Raviv及其同事回顾了150多项关于不同领域变异与泛化的研究，包括计算机科学、语言学、分类学、视觉感知和正规教育。
formal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

formal.sentenceEn: For example, the monolinguals reported, on average, a year and a half more schooling than their bilingual counterparts, so the effect was clearly not due to formal education.
formal.translationZh: 例如，样本中的单语者平均比双语者多接受一年半的学校教育，因此这种效应显然不是由正规教育导致的。

formal.sentenceEn: The third cause of poor management was associated with a deficiency of qualifications not so much the formal variety one obtains from a university, but the informal variety that comes from credible work experience and professional accomplishments.
formal.translationZh: 管理不善的第三个原因与资质欠缺有关——这里所说的资质并非主要指大学所授予的那种正规学历，而是来自可靠工作经验和专业成就的非正规资质。
formal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

fulfill.sentenceEn: The behaviors we observe leave little doubt that this fish behaviorally fulfills all criteria of the mirror test as originally laid out.
fulfill.translationZh: 我们观察到的行为几乎可以肯定，这种鱼从行为学角度完全符合最初设定的镜子测试的所有标准。
fulfill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

fulfill.sentenceEn: Well, the researchers assert that it's important to address each person's underlying cause of loneliness, whether it's the death of a spouse, medical problems, or social expectations that haven't been fulfilled .
fulfill.translationZh: 研究人员认为，重要的是要解决每个人孤独感背后的根本原因，无论是配偶离世、健康问题，还是未能实现的社会期望。
fulfill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

fulfill.sentenceEn: Computer science courses already fulfill a math or science high school graduation requirement in 28 states and the District of Columbia, up from only 12 states in 2013.
fulfill.translationZh: 在28个州和哥伦比亚特区，计算机科学课程已经满足高中毕业所需的数学或科学学分要求，相比2013年仅有12个州的情况有所增加。

fulfill.sentenceEn: Match two "onlies" and you have partners who subconsciously expect each other to continue fulfilling this expectation, while neither has much experience in the "giving" end.
fulfill.translationZh: 两个独生子女走到一起，他们会下意识地期望对方继续满足这种（受宠的）期待，而双方在付出方面都缺乏太多经验。
fulfill.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

fulfill.sentenceEn: It is a sure way to fulfill a person's dream.
fulfill.translationZh: 这是实现一个人梦想的可靠途径。

functional.sentenceEn: Place-based economic development stresses the importance of offering attractive, functional , and community-based places, such as libraries, in town squares and depressed neighborhoods.
functional.translationZh: 区位经济发展强调提供有吸引力、功能性强且以社区为基础的场所的重要性，例如城镇广场和经济欠发达社区中的图书馆。

functional.sentenceEn: Apple is an outstanding case of a company whose unique capabilities give it a worldwide competitive advantage, particularly with respect to its ability to build platforms from a product base that integrates functional and aesthetic design.
functional.translationZh: 苹果公司是一个杰出案例，其独特能力使其拥有全球竞争优势，特别是在基于产品构建平台方面的能力——这些产品整合了功能与美学设计。
functional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

functional.sentenceEn: Some species use their sense of hearing more than their eyes as a matter of adaptation to a particular lifestyle, but their eyes are still functional .
functional.translationZh: 有些蝙蝠种类为适应特定的生活方式，更多地依赖听觉而非视觉，但它们的眼睛依然具有功能。
functional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

functional.sentenceEn: The goal is functional bilingualism and biliteracy for all students by middle school.
functional.translationZh: 其目标是让所有学生到中学阶段都能具备实用的双语能力和双语读写能力。

functional.sentenceEn: Whereas now, as I near the end of my fourth decade, I realize work can be fully functional and entirely fulfilling without needing to be best mates with the people sitting next to you.
functional.translationZh: 然而如今，当我即将步入不惑之年，我意识到即使不必与邻座同事成为挚友，工作依然可以高效运转并带来十足的成就感。
functional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

functional.sentenceEn: In studies, he gave subjects a chance to deceive for monetary gain while examining their brains in a functional MRI machine, which maps blood flow to active parts of the brain.
functional.translationZh: 在研究中，他让受试者有机会通过欺骗来获取金钱利益，同时用功能性磁共振成像仪对他们的大脑进行检查，该仪器可以绘制出血液流向大脑活跃区域的情况。
functional.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

fundamentally.sentenceEn: The region's economy has been fundamentally transformed by the technology industry springing from Silicon Valley.
fundamentally.translationZh: 源自硅谷的科技产业从根本上改变了该地区的经济面貌。

fundamentally.sentenceEn: It goes without saying that this is fundamentally different from how the rest of us without beauty deals and films to publicise use the likes of Instagram, TikTok and Twitter, but even the concept of a digital detox(戒瘾) requires having a device and connectivity to choose to disconnect from.
fundamentally.translationZh: 不言而喻，这与我们这些没有美容代言和电影宣传任务的普通人使用Instagram、TikTok和Twitter等平台的方式有着本质区别，但即便是"数字戒瘾"这一概念，也需要先拥有设备和网络连接，才能选择断开连接。
fundamentally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

fundamentally.sentenceEn: "It means we won't need to dig up any more oil and, fundamentally , it should reduce the amount of plastic in the environment."
fundamentally.translationZh: 这意味着我们不再需要开采石油，并且从根本上来说，这应该能减少环境中的塑料数量。
fundamentally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

fundamentally.sentenceEn: He was able to do this because of a combination of factors—most important, timing and opportunity—but the single-mindedness and determination with which he carried out his self-imposed mission was fundamentally character-based; millions of Marconi's contemporaries had the same class, gender, race, and colonial privilege as he, but only a handful did anything with it.
fundamentally.translationZh: 他之所以能做到这一点，是多种因素共同作用的结果——其中最重要的是时机和机遇——但他执行自我设定使命时所展现的专注与决心，本质上源于他的性格特质。与马可尼同时代的数百万人拥有与他相同的阶级、性别、种族和殖民特权，但只有极少数人能善用这些优势。

fundamentally.sentenceEn: It overturned all of those habits of mind, fundamentally changing our experience of the world, affecting the conduct of politics, religion, business, and culture.
fundamentally.translationZh: 它颠覆了所有这些思维习惯，从根本上改变了我们对世界的体验，影响了政治、宗教、商业和文化的运作方式。
fundamentally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

fundamentally.sentenceEn: It turns out that, in many ways, the real trick to speaking two languages consists in managing not to speak one of those languages at a given moment—which is fundamentally a feat of paying attention.
fundamentally.translationZh: 事实证明，在很多方面，说两种语言的真正诀窍在于在特定时刻控制自己不说其中一种语言——这本质上是一种专注注意力的技能。

fur.sentenceEn: There are fur coats that are vegan, plastic vegan belts and shoes made from tree bark or natural rubber labelled vegan.
fur.translationZh: 市场上出现了纯素皮草大衣、纯素塑料腰带，以及以树皮或天然橡胶为原料制成并标注为纯素的鞋子。
fur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

fur.sentenceEn: At the top end, some of the world-renowned fashion designers have avoided leather and fur for some time.
fur.translationZh: 在高端市场，一些世界知名时装设计师已在一段时间内避免使用皮革和毛皮。
fur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

fur.sentenceEn: It was killing me inside because all that leather and fur went to waste and animals had died for nothing.
fur.translationZh: 这让我内心备受煎熬，因为所有那些皮革和毛皮都被浪费了，动物们白白死去。

fur.sentenceEn: In May this year, Burberry announced it was taking fur out of its catwalk shows and reviewing its use elsewhere in the business.
fur.translationZh: 今年5月，博柏利宣布将停止在时装秀中使用皮草，并正对业务其他环节的皮草使用情况进行重新评估。

fur.sentenceEn: They know I'm a vegetarian, that I don't wear leather or fur , and that I always use public transportation.
fur.translationZh: 他们知道我是素食主义者，不穿皮革或毛皮制品，并且总是乘坐公共交通工具。
fur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

fur.sentenceEn: So we evolved the ability to sweat plentifully and lost most of our fur .
fur.translationZh: 因此，我们进化出了大量出汗的能力，同时失去了大部分体毛。
fur.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

factual.sentenceEn: The results of the study showed that factual language activated a rapid increase in brain activity, with the brain responding more powerfully and showing more engagement with factual phrases compared to those communicating possibility.
factual.translationZh: 研究结果表明，事实性语言会引发大脑活动的快速增强，与处理表达可能性的语句相比，大脑对事实性短语的反应更强烈，参与度也更高。
factual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

factual.sentenceEn: Further, these regions respond in a much more robust fashion to factual statements.
factual.translationZh: 此外，这些区域对事实陈述的反应要强烈得多。
factual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第9句

factual.sentenceEn: "I will stay home," is also factual .
factual.translationZh: "我会待在家里"也是事实陈述。
factual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

factual.sentenceEn: "There is a monster under my bed" exemplifies a factual statement.
factual.translationZh: "床底下有一只怪物"就是一个事实陈述的例子。
factual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

factual.sentenceEn: Thus, it is more important than ever to separate the factual from the possible or merely speculative in how we communicate.
factual.translationZh: 因此，在我们的交流中，区分事实与可能性或纯粹推测比以往任何时候都更加重要。
factual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

factual.sentenceEn: The researchers compared brain responses to statements expressing factual scenarios and those expressing possibility.
factual.translationZh: 研究人员比较了大脑对表达事实情景的陈述与表达可能性的陈述的反应。
factual.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

fatal.sentenceEn: The trick, then, is to reach the third stage sooner, by focusing earlier and more closely on fatal accidents.
fatal.translationZh: 因此，关键在于通过更早、更密切地关注致命事故，从而更快地进入第三阶段。
fatal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

fatal.sentenceEn: Such wariness is well founded: statistics show, for example, that a teenage driver with a same-age passenger in the car is at higher risk of a fatal crash than an adolescent driving alone or with an adult.
fatal.translationZh: 这种担忧是有充分依据的：例如，统计数据显示，车内载有同龄乘客的青少年司机发生致命车祸的风险，比单独驾驶或与成人一起驾驶的青少年要高。

fatal.sentenceEn: Sometimes this can cause dangerous or even fatal reactions.
fatal.translationZh: 有时这会引发危险甚至致命的反应。
fatal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

fatal.sentenceEn: Any crack in that front could be fatal for tech companies that must operate worldwide.
fatal.translationZh: 对于那些必须在全球范围内运营的科技公司而言，这道防线的任何裂痕都可能是致命的。

fatal.sentenceEn: What else could be done to reduce fatal road accidents in addition to safer roads?
fatal.translationZh: 除了更安全的道路外，还能采取哪些措施来减少致命的道路交通事故？

fatal.sentenceEn: Industrial fishing and climate change could be fatal to certain Antarctic species.
fatal.translationZh: 工业捕捞和气候变化可能对某些南极物种造成致命威胁。

flavor.sentenceEn: But a big or steady serving of sarcasm will overwhelm the emotional flavor of any conversation and can taste very bitter to its recipient.
flavor.translationZh: 但大量或频繁的讽刺会盖过任何对话的情感基调，给听者留下苦涩的感受。
flavor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

flavor.sentenceEn: And when a drink that was lime flavor was colored orange, nearly half of respondents identified the flavor of the beverage as orange.
flavor.translationZh: 当一款青柠味饮料被染成橙色时，近半数受访者认为这款饮料是橙子味的。
flavor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

flavor.sentenceEn: What's happening when someone fails to identify the flavor of a beverage they can't see or that has an abnormal color?
flavor.translationZh: 当一个人无法识别一种看不见或颜色异常的饮料的味道时，会发生什么？
flavor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第7句

flavor.sentenceEn: In a 1980s study, for example, test participants were asked to name the flavor of the beverage they were drinking without being able to see that beverage.
flavor.translationZh: 例如，在20世纪80年代的一项研究中，参与者被要求在看不见所饮饮料的情况下说出其味道。
flavor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

flavor.sentenceEn: Is it that participants can't discern what the flavor is, and so rely on visual cues?
flavor.translationZh: 是不是参与者无法辨别味道，因此依赖视觉线索？
flavor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第8句

flavor.sentenceEn: But when they were allowed to see what they were drinking which was orange in color, each of them identified the orange flavor .
flavor.translationZh: 但当他们能够看到自己正在喝的是橙色饮品时，每个人都辨认出了橙子的味道。
flavor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

forge.sentenceEn: To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing.
forge.translationZh: 为了充分发挥模拟训练的效益，参与者应立即将从中获得的经验应用于实践，从而在学习与行动之间建立顺畅的联系。
forge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第5句

forge.sentenceEn: If free-traders are going to win policy arguments in the future, they'll have to find a way of forging bonds of affection between American consumers and foreign producers.
forge.translationZh: 如果自由贸易支持者未来想在政策辩论中获胜，他们必须找到一种方法，在美國消費者和外國生產者之間建立情感聯繫。

forge.sentenceEn: A Burberry spokesperson further said, "On the occasions when disposal of products is necessary, we do so in a responsible manner. We are always seeking ways to reduce and revalue our waste. This is a core part of our strategy and we have forged partnerships and committed support to innovative organizations to help reach this goal."
forge.translationZh: 博柏利发言人进一步表示：“在必须对产品进行处理的情况下，我们会以负责任的方式进行。我们一直在寻求减少浪费并提升其价值的方法。这是我们战略的核心部分，我们已与创新机构建立合作伙伴关系并提供支持，以帮助实现这一目标。”

forge.sentenceEn: This has forged a new relationship between buyer and seller.
forge.translationZh: 这在买家和卖家之间建立了一种新型关系。
forge.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

forge.sentenceEn: For their arguments to prevail, advocates of free trade must try to forge bonds of affection between consumers at home and producers overseas.
forge.translationZh: 要让自由贸易的主张获得认可，其倡导者必须努力在国内消费者与海外生产者之间建立情感纽带。

forge.sentenceEn: It is conducive to our forging better interpersonal relationships.
forge.translationZh: 这有利于我们建立更好的人际关系。

formulate.sentenceEn: The system defines ultra-processed foods as those made using sequences of processes that extract substances from foods and alter them with chemicals in order to formulate the final product.
formulate.translationZh: 该系统将超加工食品定义为：通过一系列加工过程从食物中提取物质，并使用化学物质对其进行改造以形成最终产品的食品。
formulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

formulate.sentenceEn: Computers increasingly become principal actors in leveraging data to formulate questions, which requires radically new ways of reasoning.
formulate.translationZh: 计算机正日益成为利用数据提出问题的核心角色，这需要全新的推理方式。

formulate.sentenceEn: Mathematics is the language used to formulate the laws of physics or economy, and to make rigorous computations that turn into predictions.
formulate.translationZh: 数学是用来阐述物理或经济规律，并进行可转化为预测的严谨计算的语言。

formulate.sentenceEn: In addition to avoiding obvious distractions such as cell phones and using body language to demonstrate attentiveness, it is also important to allow the other person to finish speaking before formulating our own response.
formulate.translationZh: 除了避免手机等明显干扰，并用肢体语言表现出专注外，在形成自己的回应之前，让对方把话说完也很重要。
formulate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

formulate.sentenceEn: They are matters the American government typically ignores when formulating educational policies.
formulate.translationZh: 这些都是美国政府在制定教育政策时通常会忽视的问题。

functioning.sentenceEn: Strong social connections are important for cognitive functioning , motor function and a smoothly running immune system.
functioning.translationZh: 良好的社会关系对认知功能、运动功能和免疫系统的正常运作都很重要。

functioning.sentenceEn: These real health benefits include better cognitive functioning and lowered risk of gaining weight.
functioning.translationZh: 这些切实的健康益处包括改善认知功能以及降低体重增加的风险。
functioning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

functioning.sentenceEn: In addition to their courses, students are charged with running the 155-acre ranch and overseeing the functioning of the college.
functioning.translationZh: 除课程学习外，学生们还负责管理这座155英亩的牧场，并监督学院的日常运作。

functioning.sentenceEn: But research shows that short periods of stress can actually provide some protection against getting sick, because it increases your immune functioning .
functioning.translationZh: 但研究表明，短期压力实际上可以提供一定的保护，防止生病，因为它能增强你的免疫功能。
functioning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

functioning.sentenceEn: Studies have shown that short periods of stress can actually bolster cognitive functioning .
functioning.translationZh: 研究表明，短期压力实际上可以增强认知功能。
functioning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

functioning.sentenceEn: Well, Luk found, they also scored higher on tests of executive functioning .
functioning.translationZh: 卢克发现，这些学生在执行功能测试中得分也更高。

furthermore.sentenceEn: Furthermore , our identities at work are not static.
furthermore.translationZh: 此外，我们在工作中的身份并非一成不变。
furthermore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

furthermore.sentenceEn: Furthermore , you have strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
furthermore.translationZh: 此外，您具备出色的分析能力和对细节的关注。
furthermore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

furthermore.sentenceEn: Furthermore , ethics committees should make it mandatory for researchers to share their results with the public.
furthermore.translationZh: 此外，伦理委员会应强制要求研究人员向公众分享其研究成果。
furthermore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

furthermore.sentenceEn: Furthermore , our rabbits are regularly cleaned and have all received the required shots.
furthermore.translationZh: 此外，我们的兔子定期清洁，并且都已接种了所需的疫苗。
furthermore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

furthermore.sentenceEn: Furthermore , with continuing advances in individual genome(基因组) sequencing and the advent of personalized medicine, more non-scientists will need to be comfortable analyzing complex scientific information to make decisions that directly affect their quality of life.
furthermore.translationZh: 此外，随着个人基因组测序技术的不断进步以及个性化医疗的出现，越来越多的非科研人员需要能够熟练分析复杂的科学信息，以便做出直接影响自身生活质量的决策。
furthermore.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

furthermore.sentenceEn: Furthermore , they say, it is the best way for researchers to gather the range of observations that are necessary to speed up discoveries or to identify large-scale trends.
furthermore.translationZh: 此外，他们认为，这也是研究人员收集各类观察结果的最佳方式，而这些观察结果对于加快科学发现或识别大规模趋势至关重要。
